text: Бьюсь за то, чего здесь нет.
There’s not one road to get there,
Its not just swing a sword or take it in you - oh no
It’s what you’ve given, what has left your bones bare,
It’s only then the path is yours to walk through
Take the path to the end, and a monster you’ll find sleeping,
Where the wounds cut deep in the earth are full of flowers,
He sees not what you’ve lost, the judgement is fleeting
Takes another sword, takes another sword, counts his hours…
Some take their risks, by avoiding the fight
It’s a right way to go if your wrong is your right,
But I feel my duty and honor to act,
take up in my harbor, and I’ll have your back.
Бьюсь за то, чего здесь нет.
Your friends will bring you solace
In a world where things feel edged to anger, Peace, through war
To hold your ground and get there, is strength
There’s a calm that stills the deepest hum of pain forgotten.
Some think they’ll win just by poking the bear,
It’s not the tip of your sword, that’s got me scared,
Don’t take what you want then expect me to hide,
I’ll cut long and deep, I’ll cut hard and wide.
Бьюсь за то, чего здесь нет.
Бьюсь за то, чего здесь нет.
